name: Who headed each office of the Bangsamoro Government, and when
note: Each tenure as an official source or a news report dated it; a year alone where the month was not stated. Where no source dates a start or an end, the month a source first or last shows the person in office is given instead.

history.name: Abdulraof A. Macacua
history.title: Interim Chief Minister
history.note: Took his oath before the President on 2025-03-12.

history.name: Mohagher Iqbal
history.title: Minister
history.note: The Chief Minister asked him on 2026-05-11 to resign by 2026-05-18; he confirmed his removal on 2026-05-22 (Inquirer; Manila Bulletin).

history.name: Abdulraof A. Macacua
history.title: Minister (concurrent; Chief Minister)
history.note: BusinessWorld, 2026-05-21: https://www.bworldonline.com/the-nation/2026/05/21/751372/barmm-chief-takes-over-education-ministry/

history.name: Dr. Saffrullah Dipatuan
history.title: Minister
history.note: BIO still calls him Health Minister on 2020-09-16; the month he left is not stated.

history.name: Dr. Ameril Usman
history.title: OIC Minister
history.note: Called OIC Health Minister by BIO on 2020-11-04; start month not stated.

history.name: Dr. Bashary A. Latiph
history.title: Minister
history.note: "Newly installed" in BIO, 2021-03-27. Ministers were told to tender courtesy resignations on 2022-02-08.

history.name: Dr. Zul Qarneyn Abas
history.title: OIC Minister
history.note: BIO, 2022-03-14, names him the current OIC Minister; he served until Piang was appointed.

history.name: Dr. Rizaldy Piang
history.title: Minister
history.note: Named Minister by BIO from 2022-12-09. Wikipedia, citing an MOH post that no longer loads, gives 2022-11-09.

history.name: Dr. Kadil "Jojo" Sinolinding Jr.
history.title: Minister
history.note: Took office 2024-05-06.

history.name: Atty. Raissa H. Jajurie
history.title: Minister
history.note: Re-appointed and sworn in on 2022-09-23 (https://bangsamoro.gov.ph/news/latest-news/chief-minister-ebrahims-swears-in-new-set-of-cabinet/).

history.name: Abunawas L. Maslamama
history.title: Minister
history.note: Turnover held 2025-04-14.

history.name: Archt. Eduard Uy Guerra
history.title: Minister
history.note: The reshuffle took effect 2019-11-11.

history.name: Atty. Sha Elijah Dumama-Alba
history.title: Minister
history.note: Appointed 2023-12-07.

history.name: Abdulraof A. Macacua
history.title: Minister (concurrent; Chief Minister)
history.note: Turnover held 2025-07-22.

history.name: Jordan S. Bayam
history.title: Minister
history.note: Took his oath 2026-04-06.

history.name: Atty. Hamid Aminoddin D. Barra
history.title: Minister
history.note: Start not confirmed. He was not among the 10 ministers named on 2019-02-26. BIO lists him as re-appointed on 2022-09-23. Wikipedia gives 2019-02-26. He died in office (Inquirer, 2026-01-13).

history.name: Aldin H. Asiri
history.title: Deputy Minister and Officer-in-Charge
history.note: Called OIC by BIO from 2026-02-13 to 2026-04-16.

history.name: Zaide C. Ali
history.title: Minister
history.note: BIO, 2026-05-25, calls him "newly appointed"; the date of appointment is not stated.

history.name: Abdulraof A. Macacua
history.title: Minister
history.note: Became Executive Secretary on 2019-11-11 but kept oversight of the ministry (https://bangsamoro.gov.ph/news/latest-news/bangsamoro-chief-minister-ebrahim-reshuffles-regional-cabinet/).

history.name: Akmad Brahim
history.title: Minister
history.note: Took the oath on 2022-03-14, having assumed office "weeks" earlier.

history.name: Abuamri A. Taddik
history.title: Minister
history.note: No official or news source found for the start; Wikipedia gives 2019-06-10. MTIT site bio: https://mtit.bangsamoro.gov.ph/minister/ (2023).

history.name: Farserina Mohammad
history.title: Minister
history.note: Took her oath 2025-08-04.

history.name: Dickson Hermoso
history.title: Minister
history.note: Appointment effective 2019-07-15.

history.name: Atty. Paisalin Tago, CPA
history.title: Minister
history.note: Named Minister by BIO as late as 2025-07-02. MindaNews says he was named president of the MSU System in June 2025.

history.name: Termizie G. Masahud
history.title: Minister
history.note: Wikipedia gives 2025-08-08.

history.name: Engr. Aida M. Silongan

history.note: Start not confirmed. She was not among the 10 ministers named on 2019-02-26. Wikipedia gives 2019-02-26. Re-appointed 2022-09-23 (https://bangsamoro.gov.ph/news/latest-news/chief-minister-ebrahims-swears-in-new-set-of-cabinet/).

history.name: Jehan Amella Usop

history.name: Atty. Ubaida Pacasem
history.title: Minister
history.note: Took the oath on 2022-03-14, having assumed office "weeks" earlier. Previously Deputy Minister.

history.name: Muslimin G. Sema
history.title: Minister
history.note: Took the oath on 2022-03-14, having assumed office "weeks" earlier. Wikipedia gives 2022-03-08.

history.name: Hussein P. Muñoz
history.title: Minister
history.note: Re-appointed 2022-09-23 (https://bangsamoro.gov.ph/news/latest-news/chief-minister-ebrahims-swears-in-new-set-of-cabinet/).

history.name: Guiamal B. Abdulrahman
history.title: Minister
history.note: Wikipedia gives 2025-08-01.

history.name: Engr. Mohajirin T. Ali
history.title: Director General
history.note: In 2019-04 he was Acting Executive Director of RPDO-BARMM, the precursor office. Called BPDA Director General by 2019-10. Re-appointed 2022-09-23 (https://bangsamoro.gov.ph/news/latest-news/chief-minister-ebrahims-swears-in-new-set-of-cabinet/).

history.name: Said Salendab
history.title: Executive Director
history.note: Start not found. He headed the Bangsamoro Treasury Office until the BPA was set up, then became its Executive Director. Sworn in as Senior Minister on 2026-05-18 (https://bangsamoro.gov.ph/news/latest-news/cm-macacua-installs-new-barmm-execs-pushes-accountability-agenda/).

history.name: Sheikh Abuhuraira A. Udasan
history.title: Bangsamoro Grand Mufti
history.note: "Appointed ... following the establishment of BARMM"; no date given. He died in office; a BIO article of 2024-03-07 gives his tenure as Mufti (counting his MILF Darul-Ifta years) as 2015–July 2023.

history.name: Sheikh Abdulrauf Guialani
history.title: Bangsamoro Mufti
history.note: Called "new Grand Mufti" on 2024-03-07; month of appointment not stated. No source found for who, if anyone, acted as head from July 2023 to 2024.

history.name: Atty. Abdul Rashid Kalim
history.title: Chairperson
history.note: The BHRC was created in 2020 by Bangsamoro Autonomy Act No. 4. No source found for when he was appointed or whether anyone chaired it before him.

history.name: Dr. Salem Y. Lingasa
history.title: Chairperson (and Commissioner for Maguindanao)
history.note: Installed 2021-05-26. Before then, BIO (2021-03) names Ardan Sali as BCPCH executive director.

history.name: Robert M. Alonto
history.title: Chairperson
history.note: Turnover held 2026-05-06.

history.name: Hadja Bainon G. Karon
history.title: Chairperson
history.note: Start not stated. She gave her 3rd State of the Bangsamoro Women Address in 2021-11 and her 7th in 2025-11.

history.name: Dr. Marjanie Mimbantas Macasalong
history.title: Chairperson
history.note: In 2019-12 he was Executive Director of the Office on Bangsamoro Youth Affairs. The end of his term was not found.

history.name: Nasserudin D. Dunding, MA
history.title: Chairperson
history.note: Earlier a BYC commissioner. Date of appointment as chair not found.
